lemmas.def_en: a trunk for storing personal possessions; usually kept at the foot of a bed (as in a barracks)

examples.en: The recruit neatly packed his spare uniform into the metal footlocker.
examples.zh: 新兵整齐地将备用制服收纳进金属床脚柜中。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 footlocker 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: lying or extending across the length of a thing or in a cross direction

examples.en: Lay the wooden beams crosswise to create a stronger foundation for the roof.
examples.zh: 将木梁横向放置，以便为屋顶打造更牢固的基础。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 crosswise 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 唤起情欲的, 性感的
lemmas.def_en: sensitive to sexual stimulation

examples.en: The neck is known to be a particularly sensitive erogenous zone for many.
examples.zh: 众所周知，对许多人来说颈部是格外敏感的性感带。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 erogenous 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: (古冰岛两文学集之一)：1230年问世的古冰岛散文集(或)1200年问世的古冰岛诗集
lemmas.def_en: tropical starchy tuberous root

examples.en: He studied the medieval Prose Edda to understand ancient Norse mythology and poetry.
examples.zh: 他研读中世纪的《散文埃达》，以了解古诺斯神话与诗歌。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 edda 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: the room in the palace of a native prince of India in which audiences and receptions occur

examples.en: The viceroy hosted a lavish imperial durbar to welcome the visiting foreign dignitaries.
examples.zh: 总督举办了盛大的皇家接见会，以欢迎来访的外宾。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 durbar 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: small scales from animal skins or hair or bird feathers that can cause allergic reactions in some people

examples.en: Regularly vacuuming the carpets helps eliminate airborne pet dander and reduce allergies.
examples.zh: 定期用吸尘器清理地毯有助于清除空气中的宠物皮屑并减少过敏。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 dander 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 不知的, 昏迷的, 无知觉的, 冷淡的
lemmas.def_en: incapable of physical sensation

examples.en: He fell heavily to the ground and lay completely insensible for several minutes.
examples.zh: 他重重摔倒在地，完全不省人事地躺了好几分钟。

lemmas.def_zh: 无感觉, 不在乎, 不关心
lemmas.def_en: a lack of sensibility

family_guide.root_logic: 以 insensible 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: free somebody (from an erroneous belief)

examples.en: The professor quickly disabused the students of the notion that the test was easy.
examples.zh: 教授很快打消了学生们认为这次考试很容易的念头。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 disabuse 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 易弯的, 柔韧的, 柔顺的
lemmas.def_en: capable of being influenced or formed

examples.en: Soak the willow branches in water to make them pliant enough for basket weaving.
examples.zh: 将柳枝浸入水中，使其柔韧到足以用来编织篮子。

lemmas.def_en: the property of being pliant and flexible

family_guide.root_logic: 以 pliant 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: abnormally enlarged thyroid gland; can result from underproduction or overproduction of hormone or from a deficiency of iodine in the diet

examples.en: The doctor observed that the patient's enlarged thyroid had developed into a visible goiter.
examples.zh: 医生注意到患者肿大的甲状腺已发展成肉眼可见的甲状腺肿。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 goiter 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: incapable of being compressed; resisting compression

examples.en: Engineers treat water as an incompressible fluid when analyzing high-pressure hydraulic pipe systems.
examples.zh: 工程师在分析高压液压管道系统时将水视为不可压缩流体。

lemmas.def_en: the property of being incompressible

family_guide.root_logic: 以 incompressible 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 可支持的, 可忍耐的, 可援助的
lemmas.def_en: capable of being borne though unpleasant

examples.en: The researcher presented fresh empirical data that made his controversial theory fully supportable.
examples.zh: 研究人员提出了新的实证数据，使他那颇具争议的理论完全立得住脚。

lemmas.def_zh: 忍耐不住的, 不能忍受的
lemmas.def_en: not able to be supported or defended

family_guide.root_logic: 以 supportable 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: admitting of being pardoned

examples.en: Making minor formatting mistakes on your first day is entirely pardonable and expected.
examples.zh: 第一天上班犯些格式上的小错误是完全可以原谅且在预料之中的。

lemmas.def_zh: 不可原谅的, 不可宽恕的
lemmas.def_en: not admitting of pardon

examples.en: unpardonable behavior

family_guide.root_logic: 以 pardonable 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: gnaw into; make resentful or angry

examples.en: The unfair criticism continued to rankle in his mind for many months afterward.
examples.zh: 此后数月，那番不公的批评依然让他耿耿于怀。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 rankle 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: lacking in refinement or grace or good taste

examples.en: Using duct tape to repair the cracked dashboard was an inelegant but effective solution.
examples.zh: 用强力胶带修补开裂的仪表盘虽不雅观，却很管用。

lemmas.def_en: without elegance

family_guide.root_logic: 以 inelegant 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: the end of the vertebral column in humans and tailless apes

examples.en: She slipped on the icy sidewalk and severely bruised her coccyx during the fall.
examples.zh: 她在结冰的人行道上滑倒，摔倒时严重挫伤了尾骨。

lemmas.def_en: of or relating to or near the coccyx

family_guide.root_logic: 以 coccyx 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 夹鱼子或小鱼的烤面包
lemmas.def_en: an appetizer consisting usually of a thin slice of bread or toast spread with caviar or cheese or other savory food

examples.en: The waiter circulated the room offering each guest a delicate smoked salmon canape.
examples.zh: 侍者在房间里穿梭，为每位客人递上精致的熏三文鱼开胃小吃。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 canape 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: an artificially made microscopic vesicle into which nucleic acids can be packaged; used in molecular biology as a transducing vector

examples.en: Scientists encapsulated the fragile drug inside a liposome to improve its targeted delivery.
examples.zh: 科学家将脆弱的药物封装在脂质体内，以改善其靶向递送。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 liposome 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 骗子, 非常机灵的人, 狡诈精明的人, 时髦人物
lemmas.def_en: an alert and energetic person

examples.en: A smooth-talking sharpy at the train station tricked the tourists out of their money.
examples.zh: 火车站里一个能说会道的骗子骗走了游客们的钱。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 sharpy 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: [医] 威廉斯仙人球, 龙舌兰酵汁
lemmas.def_en: a small spineless globe-shaped cactus; source of mescal buttons

examples.en: They sipped smoky mezcal from small clay cups while listening to live acoustic music.
examples.zh: 他们一边从黏土小杯中啜饮烟熏风味的梅斯卡尔酒，一边听着现场原声音乐。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 mezcal 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 海绿属植物, 难以捉摸的事物, 一心追求的事物
lemmas.def_en: European garden herb with purple-tinged flowers and leaves that are sometimes used for salads

examples.en: Tiny scarlet pimpernel flowers bloomed along the edge of the stone pathway.
examples.zh: 细小的红花海绿沿着石径边缘盛开。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 pimpernel 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: widespread European weed having yellow daisylike flowers; sometimes an obnoxious weed and toxic to cattle if consumed in quantity

examples.en: High pollen counts from blooming ragweed triggered his severe seasonal allergies.
examples.zh: 盛开的豚草散发的大量花粉引发了他严重的季节性过敏。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 ragweed 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 冰雪融化成的水,冰河融化后的水
lemmas.def_en: melted snow or ice

examples.en: In late spring, roaring meltwater rushed down from the snow-capped mountain.
examples.zh: 春末，轰鸣的冰川融水从白雪皑皑的山上奔流而下。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 meltwater 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 千变万化的, 变化不定的, (海神)普罗透斯的
lemmas.def_en: taking on different forms

examples.en: The actor was celebrated for his protean talent in widely differing roles.
examples.zh: 这位演员因在各类迥异角色中展现的多变才能而备受赞誉。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 protean 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 放荡, 不检点, 浪费
lemmas.def_en: the trait of spending extravagantly

examples.en: The prince lost the family fortune through decades of reckless gambling and profligacy.
examples.zh: 这位王子因数十年的豪赌与放荡挥霍空了家族财富。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 profligacy 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 引人怜悯的, 可怜而又可鄙的, 可怜的, 令人怜悯的
lemmas.def_en: inspiring mixed contempt and pity

examples.en: The abandoned puppy presented a pitiable sight as it shivered in the rain.
examples.zh: 那只被遗弃的小狗在雨中瑟瑟发抖，景象十分令人怜悯。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 pitiable 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 西班牙甘椒, 甘椒树
lemmas.def_en: plant bearing large mild thick-walled usually bell-shaped fruits; the principal salad peppers

examples.en: She bought a jar of green olives stuffed with sweet red pimento.
examples.zh: 她买了一罐填塞了香甜红甘椒的青橄榄。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 pimento 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: large open car seating four with folding top

examples.en: The wealthy gentleman drove a handsome horse-drawn phaeton through the crowded park.
examples.zh: 那位富绅驾驶着一辆漂亮轻巧的四轮马车穿过拥挤的公园。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 phaeton 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: the general region between the anus and the genital organs

examples.en: The surgeon monitored the patient's perineum carefully during the complex delivery.
examples.zh: 在复杂的分娩过程中，外科医生仔细监护着产妇的会阴部。

lemmas.def_en: of or relating to the perineum

examples.en: The surgeon explained that the patient might suffer minor perineal discomfort following the operation.
examples.zh: 外科医生解释说，手术后患者可能会出现轻微的会阴部不适。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 perineum 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 有助消化的, 胃液素的, 胃蛋白酶的
lemmas.def_en: relating to or promoting digestion

examples.en: Prolonged emotional stress and poor diet contributed to his severe peptic ulcer.
examples.zh: 长期的精神压力与不良饮食导致了他严重的消化性溃疡。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 peptic 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a shop where loans are made with personal property as security

examples.en: He reluctantly entered the downtown pawnshop to sell his grandfather's vintage gold watch.
examples.zh: 他极不情愿地走进市中心的当铺，卖掉了祖父留下的老金表。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 pawnshop 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: especially a light saddle horse for a woman

examples.en: The noble lady rode a gentle white palfrey beside the royal procession.
examples.zh: 这位贵妇骑着一匹温驯的白色驯马跟随在皇家队伍旁。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 palfrey 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: an irresistible sexual attraction to dead bodies

examples.en: The forensic psychologist analyzed a disturbing case that involved necrophilia and obsession.
examples.zh: 司法心理学家分析了一起涉及恋尸癖与极端执念的令人不安的案件。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 necrophilia 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: one whose business is the management of funerals

examples.en: The compassionate mortician prepared the body respectfully before the private family viewing.
examples.zh: 富有同情心的殡仪师在亲属私下告别前庄重地整理好了遗体。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 mortician 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 齐步, 快步进行曲, 快狐步舞
lemmas.def_en: military march accompanying quick time

examples.en: The talented dancers moved with dazzling speed during their energetic quickstep routine.
examples.zh: 才华横溢的舞者在充满活力的快步舞表演中舞步飞旋。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 quickstep 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: winged monster with the head of an eagle and the body of a lion

examples.en: A stone gryphon guarded the palace gate with sharp claws and spreading wings.
examples.zh: 一座石雕狮鹫张开双翼、伸出利爪，守卫着宫殿大门。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 gryphon 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 回答, 答辩, 答复
lemmas.def_en: a quick reply to a question or remark (especially a witty or critical one)

examples.en: Her sharp, witty rejoinder left the smug critic completely unable to respond.
examples.zh: 她敏锐风趣的反驳让自鸣得意的批评家顿时哑口无言。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 rejoinder 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: [计] 远程交换, 电信工作方式
lemmas.def_en: employment at home while communicating with the workplace by phone or fax or modem

examples.en: Many modern companies allow telecommuting to reduce office costs and boost flexibility.
examples.zh: 许多现代企业允许远程办公以降低办公成本并提高灵活性。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 telecommuting 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 凉廊, 房屋敞向花园的部份
lemmas.def_en: a roofed arcade or gallery with open sides stretching along the front or side of a building; often at an upper level

examples.en: We enjoyed our morning coffee on the shaded loggia overlooking the garden.
examples.zh: 我们在俯瞰花园的凉廊荫凉处享用了清晨的咖啡。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 loggia 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: of or relating to or constituting zoonosis

examples.en: Scientists study wildlife pathogens to prevent deadly zoonotic diseases from jumping to humans.
examples.zh: 科学家研究野生动物病原体，以防止致命的动物传染病扩散到人类。

lemmas.def_en: an animal disease that can be transmitted to humans

examples.en: Rabies is a well-known zoonosis that can be transmitted to humans.
examples.zh: 狂犬病是一种众所周知的可传染给人类的人畜共患病。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 zoonotic 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: (medicine) the chemical analysis of urine (for medical diagnosis)

examples.en: The doctor ordered a routine urinalysis to check for any signs of infection.
examples.zh: 医生安排了常规尿检，以检查是否存在任何感染迹象。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 urinalysis 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: the brush (small trees and bushes and ferns etc.) growing beneath taller trees in a wood or forest

examples.en: The frightened deer quickly darted into the thick underbrush to hide from predators.
examples.zh: 受惊的鹿迅速窜入茂密的林下灌丛以躲避捕食者。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 underbrush 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 弓形体病, 弓浆虫病
lemmas.def_en: infection caused by parasites transmitted to humans from infected cats; if contracted by a pregnant woman it can result in serious damage to the fetus

examples.en: Pregnant women are advised to avoid cat litter to reduce the risk of toxoplasmosis.
examples.zh: 建议孕妇避开猫砂以降低感染弓形体病的风险。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 toxoplasmosis 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: resident of a college town not affiliated with the college

examples.en: As a local townie, Mark often felt annoyed by the loud college students.
examples.zh: 作为当地居民，马克经常被吵闹的大学生弄得心烦意乱。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 townie 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: infections of the skin or nails caused by fungi and appearing as itching circular patches

examples.en: The doctor prescribed an antifungal ointment to treat the persistent case of tinea.
examples.zh: 医生开了一种抗真菌药膏来治疗这种顽固的癣。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 tinea 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: one trillion periods per second

examples.en: Scientists are developing new imaging technologies using advanced terahertz radiation to scan luggage.
examples.zh: 科学家正开发利用先进太赫兹辐射扫描行李的新型成像技术。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 terahertz 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 写在上面的, 标在字符的上角的, 上标的
lemmas.def_en: written or printed above and to one side of another character

examples.en: Please use a superscript number to indicate the footnote reference in your paper.
examples.zh: 请在论文中使用上标数字来标明脚注引用。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 superscript 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a large conical loaf of concentrated refined sugar

examples.en: In the past, people had to chop pieces from a solid sugarloaf for tea.
examples.zh: 过去，人们必须从坚硬的塔糖上切下碎块来泡茶。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 sugarloaf 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: T-shaped cleaning implement with a rubber edge across the top; drawn across a surface to remove water (as in washing windows)

examples.en: He used a rubber squeegee to wipe the excess soapy water off the windshield.
examples.zh: 他用橡胶刮板擦掉了挡风玻璃上多余的肥皂水。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 squeegee 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 镜子的, 镜子一般的, 会反射的
lemmas.def_en: capable of reflecting light like a mirror

examples.en: The calm lake provided a specular reflection of the snowy mountain peaks above.
examples.zh: 平静的湖面如镜子般倒映着上方覆雪的山峰。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 specular 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 预言者, 占卜者, 预测未来者, 螳螂
lemmas.def_en: someone who makes predictions of the future (usually on the basis of special knowledge)

examples.en: The emperor dismissed the warning of the ancient soothsayer and marched to war anyway.
examples.zh: 皇帝无视了老预言家的警告，依旧进军出征。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 soothsayer 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a variety of black bass; the angle of the jaw falls below the eye

examples.en: He spent the entire morning trying to catch a trophy smallmouth in the clear river.
examples.zh: 他花了一整个上午试图在清澈的河里钓到一条大号小口黑鲈。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 smallmouth 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a woman shepherd

examples.en: The young shepherdess guided her flock of sheep across the lush green meadow.
examples.zh: 年轻的牧羊女引导着她的羊群穿过郁郁葱葱的草地。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 shepherdess 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 过于感伤的作品, 伤感
lemmas.def_en: (Yiddish) excessive sentimentality in art or music

examples.en: The romantic movie relied too heavily on holiday schmaltz rather than genuine emotion.
examples.zh: 这部浪漫电影过于依赖节日的煽情俗套，而非真情实感。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 schmaltz 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: (Hinduism) an ascetic holy man

examples.en: A wandering sadhu sat quietly beneath the banyan tree, lost in deep meditation.
examples.zh: 一位云游的印度圣人静静坐在榕树下，陷入沉思。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 sadhu 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: of or relating to or characteristic of wolves

examples.en: The villain stared at his rivals with cold, lupine eyes before speaking.
examples.zh: 这个恶棍在开口前，用冰冷而凶残的眼神盯着他的对手。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 lupine 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 痈, 红玉, 红榴石
lemmas.def_en: deep-red cabochon garnet cut without facets

examples.en: The painful carbuncle on his neck required immediate minor surgery by a doctor.
examples.zh: 他颈部疼痛的痈需要医生立即进行小手术。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 carbuncle 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: an extensive grassy and nearly treeless plain (especially in Latin America)

examples.en: Cattle grazed quietly across the vast, treeless expanse of the South American llano.
examples.zh: 牛群在南美辽阔无树的大草原上安静地吃草。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 llano 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: an older or native quarter of many cities in northern Africa; the quarter in which the citadel is located

examples.en: Tourists loved to wander through the winding alleys of the historic city casbah.
examples.zh: 游客们喜欢在这座历史悠久的古城堡曲折的小巷中漫步。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 casbah 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a commercially operated park with stalls and shows for amusement

examples.en: The children were thrilled to spend Saturday evening riding the carousel at the funfair.
examples.zh: 孩子们非常兴奋能在周六晚上去游乐场坐旋转木马。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 funfair 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 自由意志的, 任意的, 自愿的
lemmas.def_en: done of your own accord

examples.en: The organization relies entirely on freewill donations from community members to survive.
examples.zh: 该组织完全依靠社区成员的自愿捐赠来维持运转。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 freewill 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: strict conformity to the letter of the law rather than its spirit

examples.en: Excessive bureaucratic legalism often prevents the agency from responding quickly to public crises.
examples.zh: 过度的官僚文牍主义往往阻碍该机构迅速应对公众危机。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 legalism 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: of nerves and nerve impulses; conveying information away from the CNS

examples.en: Motor signals are carried from the spinal cord to muscles along efferent nerve fibers.
examples.zh: 运动信号沿着传出神经纤维从脊髓传递到肌肉。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 efferent 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: the sphere of work by women

examples.en: She wound raw wool onto the traditional wooden distaff before beginning to spin.
examples.zh: 在开始纺纱之前，她将原羊毛缠绕在传统的木质卷线杆上。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 distaff 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 遍及全郡（或县）的；全郡（或县）的
lemmas.def_en: occurring or extending throughout a county

examples.en: Police launched a countywide search to locate the missing elderly woman quickly.
examples.zh: 警方展开了全县范围的搜寻，以迅速找到失踪的老妇人。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 countywide 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 琐碎的细节, 不重要的工作
lemmas.def_en: a false statement that is considered to indicate timidity or fear

examples.en: Stop wasting our time with this chickenshit and address the real project issues.
examples.zh: 别再拿这些鸡毛蒜皮的琐事浪费时间了，解决项目的实际问题吧。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 chickenshit 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 生热的, 产热的, (热)卡的
lemmas.def_en: heat-generating

examples.en: Nuts are delicious, but their high calorific value makes them easy to overeat.
examples.zh: 坚果很美味，但其高热量值让人很容易吃多。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 calorific 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 用手势的, 通过手势的
lemmas.def_en: used of the language of the deaf

examples.en: The mime used rich gestural language to convey deep sorrow without speaking.
examples.zh: 这位哑剧演员用丰富的手势语言表达了无言的深沉悲伤。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 gestural 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: armor plate that protects the arm

examples.en: The military police officer wore a bright red brassard on his left arm.
examples.zh: 宪兵左臂上佩戴着一个鲜红色的臂章。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 brassard 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 学者, 文人, 书商
lemmas.def_en: a learned person (especially in the humanities); someone who by long study has gained mastery in one or more disciplines

examples.en: The elderly bookman spent decades collecting rare manuscripts from across the country.
examples.zh: 这位上了年纪的学者兼书商花了数十年在全国各地收集珍贵手稿。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 bookman 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: linear with respect to each of two variables or positions

examples.en: The mathematician used a bilinear transformation to map the complex plane accurately.
examples.zh: 数学家使用双线性变换来精确映射复平面。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 bilinear 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a member of the beat generation; a nonconformist in dress and behavior

examples.en: He dressed like a typical beatnik, wearing a black turtleneck and writing poetry.
examples.zh: 他穿着典型的“垮掉一代”服饰，身着黑色高领毛衣并写着诗歌。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 beatnik 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: slender bristlelike appendage found on the bracts of grasses

examples.en: The sharp awn of the barley caught on the fabric of his trousers.
examples.zh: 大麦尖锐的芒刺勾住了他的裤子面料。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 awn 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: report or maintain

examples.en: Witnesses aver that the car was speeding well before it reached the intersection.
examples.zh: 目击者坚称，这辆车在到达十字路口之前就已经严重超速了。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 aver 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: at or near or toward the center of a ship

examples.en: The heavy torpedo struck the cargo vessel directly amidships, causing severe flooding.
examples.zh: 重型鱼雷直接击中了货船的中部，导致严重进水。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 amidships 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 放弃, 舍弃, 克制
lemmas.def_en: the denial and rejection of a doctrine or belief

examples.en: Her career as a humanitarian required constant abnegation of personal comfort.
examples.zh: 她的人道主义工作生涯需要不断克制并放弃个人舒适。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 abnegation 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: in a gay manner

examples.en: The town square was gaily decorated with colorful lanterns for the spring festival.
examples.zh: 城镇广场上喜气洋洋地装点着五彩灯笼以庆祝春节。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 gaily 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 比喻的, 由人形象构成的, 具有人的形象的, 借喻的
lemmas.def_en: consisting of or forming human or animal figures; ; - Herbert Read

examples.en: The museum exhibited several ancient vases painted with intricate figural scenes.
examples.zh: 博物馆展出了几件绘有人物形象场景的精美古代陶瓶。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 figural 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 不顺从的, 地位不低的
lemmas.def_en: not submissive to authority

examples.en: The manager dismissed the insubordinate employee after repeated refusals to follow orders.
examples.zh: 在屡次拒绝服从命令后，经理开除了这名不服管教的员工。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 insubordinate 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a cocktail made of gin or vodka and lime juice

examples.en: He used a small gimlet to drill a guide hole into the oak board.
examples.zh: 他用一把小手钻在橡木板上钻出了一个定位孔。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 gimlet 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 不妥当的, 不明智的, 失策的
lemmas.def_en: not prudent or wise; not recommended

examples.en: It is inadvisable to hike in the mountains during severe weather alerts.
examples.zh: 在发布恶劣天气警报期间去山里徒步是极不明智的。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 inadvisable 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 不法, 私生, 不规则性, 不合逻辑
lemmas.def_en: the status of being born to parents who were not married

examples.en: Historical laws heavily penalized illegitimacy, denying children their basic inheritance rights.
examples.zh: 历史上的法律严厉惩罚私生身份，剥夺了孩子基本的继承权。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 illegitimacy 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 不节制的, 不温和的, 饮酒过度的
lemmas.def_en: (of weather or climate) not mild; subject to extremes

examples.en: His intemperate drinking eventually ruined his health and damaged his professional career.
examples.zh: 他不加节制的饮酒最终摧垮了他的健康并毁掉了他的职业生涯。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 intemperate 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 沮丧的, 生气的, 抑郁的, 着迷的
lemmas.def_en: having hips; or having hips as specified (usually in combination)

examples.en: She felt completely hipped after hearing the disappointing news about her application.
examples.zh: 得知申请被拒的令人失望的消息后，她感到无比沮丧。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 hipped 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: equipped with or wearing a helmet

examples.en: A group of helmeted cyclists sped down the hill in tight formation.
examples.zh: 一群戴着头盔的自行车手以紧凑的队形沿着山坡疾驰而下。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 helmeted 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: arising or occurring between species

examples.en: Scientists are studying interspecies communication between dolphins and other marine animals.
examples.zh: 科学家们正在研究海豚与其他海洋动物之间的种间交流。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 interspecies 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: East Indian tree cultivated for its immense edible fruit and seeds

examples.en: Ripe jackfruit has a wonderfully sweet aroma that fills the entire kitchen quickly.
examples.zh: 成熟的波罗蜜散发着奇妙的甜香，很快就弥漫了整个厨房。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 jackfruit 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a female godchild

examples.en: He bought a silver necklace as a special gift for his beloved goddaughter.
examples.zh: 他买了一条银项链，作为送给他心爱教女的特别礼物。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 goddaughter 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: [医] 血管小球的, 小球的
lemmas.def_en: of or relating to glomeruli

examples.en: The physician ordered additional tests to evaluate the patient's deteriorating glomerular filtration rate.
examples.zh: 医生要求进行额外的检查，以评估该患者不断恶化的肾小球滤过率。

lemmas.def_zh: 小球, 肾小球, 血管小球
lemmas.def_en: a small intertwined group of capillaries in the malpighian body; it filters the blood during urine formation

examples.en: Each kidney contains millions of nephrons, each with a microscopic filtering glomerulus.
examples.zh: 每个肾脏都包含数百万个肾单位，每个肾单位都有一个微小的过滤肾小球。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 glomerular 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a policy of the Soviet government allowing freer discussion of social problems

examples.en: The policy of glasnost encouraged open debate and transformed the country's political landscape.
examples.zh: 公开化政策鼓励了公开辩论，改变了该国的政治格局。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 glasnost 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a yellow viscous animal oil extracted from wool; a mixture of fatty acids and esters; used in some ointments and cosmetics

examples.en: Apply a small amount of lanolin cream to heal your dry and cracked lips.
examples.zh: 涂抹少许羊毛脂霜来治愈你干燥皲裂的嘴唇。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 lanolin 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 不容置疑地, 明确地, 无疑地
lemmas.def_en: in a manner or to a degree that could not be doubted

examples.en: Her extraordinary musical talent made her indubitably the best performer of the evening.
examples.zh: 她非凡的音乐才华使她无疑成为当晚最出色的表演者。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 indubitably 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 使乘火车, 拖, 产生, 导致；乘火车
lemmas.def_en: board a train

examples.en: The soldiers gathered on the platform, preparing to entrain for the northern border.
examples.zh: 士兵们在站台上集合，准备乘火车前往北部边境。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 entrain 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 怪想, 奇想, 小钩
lemmas.def_en: a sharp curve or crook; a shape resembling a hook

examples.en: The eccentric professor had a strange crotchet about never wearing matching colored socks.
examples.zh: 这位古怪的教授有个怪癖，就是从不穿颜色相配的袜子。

lemmas.def_zh: 有怪想的, 反复无常的, 想入非非的
lemmas.def_en: having a difficult and contrary disposition; - Dorothy Sayers

examples.en: a cantankerous and venomous-tongued old lady

family_guide.root_logic: 以 crotchet 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a plant body without true stems or roots or leaves or vascular system; characteristic of the thallophytes

examples.en: The simple green thallus of the liverwort absorbed moisture directly from wet rocks.
examples.zh: 地钱简单的绿色叶状体直接从潮湿的岩石中吸收水分。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 thallus 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: grant remission of a sin to

examples.en: The elderly priest was summoned to shrive the dying soldier in his tent.
examples.zh: 那位年迈的神父被召至帐篷中，为垂死的士兵听忏悔并赦免。

lemmas.def_en: grant remission of a sin to

examples.en: The priest absolved him and told him to say ten Hail Mary's

family_guide.root_logic: 以 shrive 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: the male reproductive cell; the male gamete

examples.en: Under the microscope, a single active spermatozoon successfully penetrated the protective outer membrane.
examples.zh: 在显微镜下，一个活跃的精子成功穿透了保护性外膜。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 spermatozoon 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: sad beyond comforting; incapable of being consoled

examples.en: The disconsolate boy sat by the empty goalpost after his team lost.
examples.zh: 输掉比赛后，那个郁郁不乐的男孩独自坐在空荡荡的球门柱旁。

lemmas.def_zh: 悲伤地, 愁闷地; 哭丧着脸
lemmas.def_en: in grief-stricken loneliness; without comforting circumstances or prospects

family_guide.root_logic: 以 disconsolate 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 过度的, 过分的, 令人生厌的
lemmas.def_en: unpleasantly and excessively suave or ingratiating in manner or speech

examples.en: Her fulsome praise sounded insincere and made everyone in the room feel uncomfortable.
examples.zh: 她过分虚浮的奉承听起来很不真诚，让屋里的每个人都感到不适。

lemmas.def_en: in an unctuous manner

family_guide.root_logic: 以 fulsome 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 瞪眼, 怒目而视, 凝视
lemmas.def_en: look at with a fixed gaze

examples.en: He could only glower in silent anger as his rival accepted the trophy.
examples.zh: 当对手接过奖杯时，他只能在无声的愤怒中怒目而视。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 glower 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 使骨化, 使硬化, 使僵化；骨化, 硬化, 变得极端保守
lemmas.def_en: become bony

examples.en: Without fresh ideas, the organization's rigid management structure will eventually ossify completely.
examples.zh: 若缺乏新思路，该机构僵化的管理体制最终将彻底变得僵化。

lemmas.def_zh: 成骨, 变骨, 骨化, (思想的)僵化
lemmas.def_en: the developmental process of bone formation

examples.en: Critics warned that bureaucracy was causing a dangerous ossification of the party system.
examples.zh: 批评人士警告说，官僚主义正导致政党体系出现危险的僵化。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 ossify 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a cloth covering (a legging) that covers the instep and ankles

examples.en: He fastened each leather gaiter tightly around his boot before hiking through snow.
examples.zh: 在雪地徒步之前，他将皮绑腿紧紧系在靴子上。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 gaiter 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: (chemistry) having valence; usually used in combination

examples.en: The chemist investigated how multivalent ions interact differently with the charged polymer surface.
examples.zh: 化学家研究了多价离子与带电聚合物表面的不同相互作用。

lemmas.def_en: the phenomenon of forming chemical bonds

family_guide.root_logic: 以 valent 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: cavity formed by the pharynx at the back of the mouth

examples.en: The doctor used a tongue depressor to inspect the patient's swollen oropharynx.
examples.zh: 医生用压舌板检查了患者肿胀的口咽部。

lemmas.def_en: of or relating to or located near the oropharynx

family_guide.root_logic: 以 oropharynx 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a toxin produced by a fungus

examples.en: Improper grain storage can lead to dangerous mycotoxin contamination that threatens health.
examples.zh: 粮食储存不当可能会导致危险的霉菌毒素污染，威胁健康。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 mycotoxin 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a chemical substance obtained from plants that is biologically active but not nutritive

examples.en: Berries contain a potent phytochemical known to protect human cells from oxidative damage.
examples.zh: 浆果中含有一种已知的强效植物化学物质，可保护人体细胞免受氧化损伤。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 phytochemical 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: [化][物][生]胶束,胶囊,微胞,微团,胶态离子
lemmas.def_en: an electrically charged particle built up from polymeric molecules or ions and occurring in certain colloidal electrolytic solutions like soaps and detergents

examples.en: Surfactant molecules spontaneously assemble into a spherical micelle structure in water.
examples.zh: 表面活性剂分子在水中会自发聚集形成球形胶束结构。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 micelle 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: measurement and study of the human body and its parts and capacities

examples.en: The designer relied on ergonomic anthropometry data to construct the comfortable office chair.
examples.zh: 设计师依靠人体工程学的人体测量学数据来制造这款舒适的办公椅。

lemmas.def_en: of or relating to anthropometry

family_guide.root_logic: 以 anthropometry 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 得票多于(对方), 以票数胜过
lemmas.def_en: defeat by a majority of votes

examples.en: The minority shareholders feared the board would easily outvote their collective proposal.
examples.zh: 少数股东担心董事会会以多数票轻易否决他们的联合提案。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 outvote 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a transparent lubricating mucous membrane that covers the eyeball and the under surface of the eyelid

examples.en: Bacterial infection caused the clear conjunctiva of his left eye to turn pink.
examples.zh: 细菌感染导致他左眼透明的结膜变成了粉红色。

lemmas.def_en: of or relating to the conjunctiva

family_guide.root_logic: 以 conjunctiva 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: the anatomy of the nervous system

examples.en: Medical students spend months studying neuroanatomy to understand how the brain functions.
examples.zh: 医学生花数月时间学习神经解剖学以了解大脑如何运作。

lemmas.def_en: of or relating to neural tissue or the nervous system

family_guide.root_logic: 以 neuroanatomy 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a Spanish or Portuguese or Latin American spectacle; a matador baits and (usually) kills a bull in an arena before many spectators

examples.en: Thousands of spectators gathered at the arena to watch the traditional bullfight.
examples.zh: 成千上万的观众聚集在竞技场观看传统的斗牛表演。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 bullfight 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: theater light at the front of a stage that illuminate the set and actors

examples.en: The nervous young actress stepped before the footlights and began her monologue.
examples.zh: 这位紧张的年轻女演员走到了脚灯前，开始了独白。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 footlights 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a graphical recording of the cardiac cycle produced by an electrocardiograph

examples.en: The doctor ordered an electrocardiogram to check for any irregular heart rhythms.
examples.zh: 医生安排了心电图检查以排查心律不齐。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 electrocardiogram 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: gibberish and nonsense

examples.en: With a wave of his wand and a shout of abracadabra, the rabbit vanished.
examples.zh: 他一挥魔杖并大喊一声咒语，兔子就消失了。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 abracadabra 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 碑文, 题铭, 题词
lemmas.def_en: a quotation at the beginning of some piece of writing

examples.en: The author chose a poignant epigraph from Shakespeare for her latest novel.
examples.zh: 作者为她的最新小说挑选了一段莎士比亚的凄美题词。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 epigraph 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a protective covering for the front of a machine or device (as a door lock or computer component)

examples.en: You can easily replace the plastic faceplate to match the room's new decor.
examples.zh: 你可以轻松更换塑料面板，以匹配房间的新装修风格。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 faceplate 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 健全至上（对能力缺失者的歧视或偏见, 尤指针对身体残障人士）
lemmas.def_en: discrimination in favor of the able-bodied

examples.en: Activists are working hard to eliminate ableism and make public spaces accessible.
examples.zh: 活动家们正努力消除残障歧视，让公共场所变得无障碍。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 ableism 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: tableware that is relatively flat and fashioned as a single piece

examples.en: She polished the silver flatware carefully before setting the formal dinner table.
examples.zh: 摆放正式宴席餐具前，她仔细擦亮了银质刀叉。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 flatware 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 功能论, 机能心理学, 功能主义, 实用第一主义
lemmas.def_en: a psychology based on the assumption that all mental process are useful to an organism in adapting to the environment

examples.en: The architect embraced functionalism, designing buildings that prioritized practical utility over decoration.
examples.zh: 该建筑师推崇功能主义，设计的建筑注重实用而非装饰。

lemmas.def_en: an adherent of functionalism

examples.en: As a functionalist, the architect believed that design must serve practical needs.
examples.zh: 作为一名功能主义者，该建筑师认为设计必须服务于实用需求。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 functionalism 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 不是必要的, 可有可无的
lemmas.def_en: capable of being dispensed with or done without

examples.en: During the company restructuring, many middle management positions were deemed dispensable.
examples.zh: 在公司重组期间，许多中层管理职位被认为是可有可无的。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 dispensable 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a temporary bridge for getting on and off a vessel at dockside

examples.en: Passengers carefully walked down the narrow gangplank to board the ferry.
examples.zh: 乘客们小心翼翼地走下狭窄的跳板登上渡轮。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 gangplank 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a soup made with chopped tomatoes and onions and cucumbers and peppers and herbs; served cold

examples.en: A cold bowl of gazpacho is refreshing on a hot summer afternoon.
examples.zh: 在炎热的夏日午后，一碗冰凉的西班牙凉菜汤令人神清气爽。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 gazpacho 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a rich meat stew highly seasoned with paprika

examples.en: We enjoyed a hearty bowl of beef goulash seasoned with sweet paprika.
examples.zh: 我们享用了一大碗用甜红椒粉调味的丰盛牛肉汤。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 goulash 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: in a subordinate position

examples.en: The queen was accompanied everywhere by her devoted and discreet handmaid.
examples.zh: 女王无论去哪儿都有她忠诚谨慎的侍女陪伴。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 handmaid 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a free-reed instrument in which air is forced through the reeds by bellows

examples.en: He played a simple hymn on the antique harmonium in the chapel.
examples.zh: 他在小教堂那架古旧的簧风琴上弹奏了一首简单的赞美诗。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 harmonium 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: lowering the body's normal immune response to invasion by foreign substances; can be deliberate (as in lowering the immune response to prevent rejection of a transplanted organ) or incidental (as a side effect of radiotherapy or chemotherapy for cancer)

examples.en: Organ transplant recipients require medication to induce immunosuppression and prevent rejection.
examples.zh: 器官移植接受者需要药物来诱导免疫抑制以防止排斥反应。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 immunosuppression 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a belligerent grouch

examples.en: Don't let that hothead provoke you into starting an unnecessary fight.
examples.zh: 别让那个急躁的家伙挑衅你引发不必要的争斗。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 hothead 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: an American infantryman in World War I

examples.en: The old museum displayed a uniform worn by an American doughboy in 1918.
examples.zh: 这家老旧的博物馆陈列着一件1918年美国陆军步兵穿过的军服。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 doughboy 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: inflammation of the urinary bladder and ureters

examples.en: Drinking plenty of water can help relieve the uncomfortable symptoms of cystitis.
examples.zh: 多喝水有助于缓解膀胱炎带来的不适症状。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 cystitis 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 财务主管, 领取奖学金的学生
lemmas.def_en: the treasurer at a college or university

examples.en: Please submit your tuition payment receipt directly to the university bursar.
examples.zh: 请将学费缴纳收据直接提交给大学财务主管。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 bursar 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: rude and boorish

examples.en: It would be churlish to refuse their generous offer of hospitality.
examples.zh: 拒绝他们慷慨热情的招待会显得很不礼貌。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 churlish 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a soft silver-white ductile metallic element (liquid at normal temperatures); the most electropositive and alkaline metal

examples.en: Atomic clocks use the resonance frequency of caesium atoms to measure time accurately.
examples.zh: 原子钟利用铯原子的共振频率来精确测量时间。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 caesium 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: having relatively broad rather than needlelike or scalelike leaves

examples.en: The surrounding forest is dominated by broadleaf trees like oak and maple.
examples.zh: 周围的森林主要由橡树和枫树等阔叶树构成。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 broadleaf 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: the basic unit of luminous intensity adopted under the Systeme International d'Unites; equal to 1/60 of the luminous intensity per square centimeter of a black body radiating at the temperature of 2,046 degrees Kelvin

examples.en: A standard wax candle emits light with an intensity of roughly one candela.
examples.zh: 一根普通的蜡烛发出的光强度大约为一坎德拉。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 candela 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: flesh of a castrated male chicken

examples.en: The chef roasted a tender capon with rosemary and garlic for the feast.
examples.zh: 厨师用迷迭香和大蒜烤了一只鲜嫩的阉鸡作为盛宴的主菜。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 capon 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 水虎鱼；南美洲的一种食人鱼
lemmas.def_en: small voraciously carnivorous freshwater fishes of South America that attack and destroy living animals

examples.en: Swimmers avoided the river due to reports of aggressive caribe in the water.
examples.zh: 由于有报告称水中出现凶猛的水虎鱼，游泳者避开了这条河。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 caribe 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: orchid growing along streams or ponds of western North America having leafy stems and 1 greenish-brown and pinkish flower in the axil of each upper leaf

examples.en: Her little brother is such a chatterbox that he rarely pauses for breath.
examples.zh: 她的小弟弟是个话匣子，说话几乎都不带喘气的。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 chatterbox 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: sudden restriction on an activity

examples.en: The government announced a sudden clampdown on illegal street vendors last week.
examples.zh: 政府上周宣布对街头无照商贩进行突击取缔。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 clampdown 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: relating to or containing the azo radical

examples.en: The textile factory uses bright azo dyes to produce colorful cotton fabrics.
examples.zh: 这家纺织厂使用鲜艳的偶氮染料来生产色彩斑斓的棉织物。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 azo 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: stiff coarse fiber from the outer husk of a coconut

examples.en: We placed a durable mat made from natural coir at our front door.
examples.zh: 我们在前门铺了一块用天然椰壳纤维制成的耐用门垫。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 coir 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 小柱, 螺的轴柱, 蒴轴
lemmas.def_en: a small column (or structure resembling a column) that is a part of a plant or animal

examples.en: The biologist examined the delicate columella inside the fractured sea shell carefully.
examples.zh: 生物学家仔细检查了破碎贝壳内部精细的轴柱结构。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 columella 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a man who is a member of committee

examples.en: Each committeeman voted in favor of the new local healthcare policy yesterday.
examples.zh: 每位委员昨天都对这项新的地方医疗政策投了赞成票。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 committeeman 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 良心的责备, 后悔, 悔恨
lemmas.def_en: a feeling of deep regret (usually for some misdeed)

examples.en: He stole the money without the slightest compunction or hesitation at all.
examples.zh: 他毫不犹豫地偷了钱，内心没有丝毫愧疚。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 compunction 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 糖果店, 糖果, 蜜饯
lemmas.def_en: a confectioner's shop

examples.en: The bakery displays an impressive assortment of sweet confectionary in the window.
examples.zh: 这家面包店的橱窗里陈列着各式各样令人诱人的甜食点心。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 confectionary 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 皮质甾醇, 氢化可的松
lemmas.def_en: an adrenal-cortex hormone (trade names Hydrocortone or Cortef) that is active in carbohydrate and protein metabolism

examples.en: She applied a thin layer of hydrocortisone cream to soothe her itchy skin.
examples.zh: 她涂了一层薄薄的氢化可的松乳膏来缓解皮肤瘙痒。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 hydrocortisone 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 麦秆编制的帽子, 来航鸡
lemmas.def_en: a stiff hat made of straw with a flat crown

examples.en: The farmer bought a white Leghorn hen known for producing many eggs.
examples.zh: 农夫买了一只以产蛋量高著称的白色来航鸡。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 leghorn 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 海豹群, 群栖处, 企鹅群, 贫民窟, 同类人的集中处, 同类物的集中处
lemmas.def_en: a breeding ground for gregarious birds (such as rooks)

examples.en: Tourists gathered near the coast to watch the noisy rookery of penguins.
examples.zh: 游客们聚集在海岸附近，观赏嘈杂的企鹅群栖地。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 rookery 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a projection at the end of a piece of wood that is shaped to fit into a mortise and form a mortise joint

examples.en: The carpenter carefully fitted the tenon into the mortise to build the chair.
examples.zh: 木匠仔细地将榫头嵌入榫眼中以制作这把椅子。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 tenon 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a hole (in a door or an oven etc) through which you can peep

examples.en: She always looks through the peephole before unlocking the heavy apartment door.
examples.zh: 在打开公寓厚重的门之前，她总是先透过窥视孔往外看。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 peephole 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 现代派后期艺术家(或艺术)的；后现代主义艺术家(或艺术)的
lemmas.def_en: of or relating to postmodernism

examples.en: The architect designed a postmodernist library featuring bold geometric shapes and colors.
examples.zh: 这位建筑师设计了一座以后现代主义风格为特色的图书馆，运用了大胆的几何形状和色彩。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 postmodernist 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 工作熟练的, 有技巧的, 精巧的
lemmas.def_en: worthy of a good workman

examples.en: The team delivered a solid, workmanlike performance to win the difficult match.
examples.zh: 该队表现扎实熟练，赢得了这场艰苦的比赛。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 workmanlike 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 舞台前部, 幕布及其装置, 舞台, 前部
lemmas.def_en: the part of a modern theater stage between the curtain and the orchestra (i.e., in front of the curtain)

examples.en: The velvet red curtain rose slowly above the historic theater's ornate proscenium.
examples.zh: 天鹅绒红幕在这座历史悠久的剧院华丽的舞台口上方缓缓升起。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 proscenium 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a vocal passage of narrative text that a singer delivers with natural rhythms of speech

examples.en: The opera singer delivered the dramatic recitative before transitioning into the main aria.
examples.zh: 歌剧演员在转入主咏叹调之前，朗诵了极富戏剧性的宣叙调。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 recitative 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a shed for storing firewood or garden tools

examples.en: He stacked the dry logs neatly inside the small woodshed behind the cabin.
examples.zh: 他把干燥的原木整齐地堆放在小木屋后面的柴房里。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 woodshed 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 两人一组, 两个一组, 两人玩的游戏
lemmas.def_en: two items of the same kind

examples.en: The romantic twosome spent the entire quiet evening strolling along the lake.
examples.zh: 这对浪漫的二人整晚都在湖边漫步，享受静谧时光。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 twosome 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: an agent that represses

examples.en: The biological repressor binds directly to DNA to block specific gene expression.
examples.zh: 该生物阻遏蛋白直接与DNA结合以阻断特定基因的表达。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 repressor 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: flesh of a large European flatfish

examples.en: The chef gently poached the fresh turbot in a delicate white wine sauce.
examples.zh: 大厨用精美白葡萄酒汁文火慢炖新鲜的大菱鲆。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 turbot 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 波浪字符；加在西班牙语n字上的发音符号
lemmas.def_en: a diacritical mark (~) placed over the letter n in Spanish to indicate a palatal nasal sound or over a vowel in Portuguese to indicate nasalization

examples.en: Remember to add a tilde over the letter n when spelling that Spanish word.
examples.zh: 拼写那个西班牙语单词时，记得在字母n上方加一个波浪符号。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 tilde 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 根茎, 根源, 起源
lemmas.def_en: a horizontal plant stem with shoots above and roots below serving as a reproductive structure

examples.en: Apple growers usually graft sweet fruit varieties onto a hardy, disease-resistant rootstock.
examples.zh: 苹果种植者通常会将优质甜味品种嫁接到抗病耐寒的砧木上。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 rootstock 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 可旋转的, 可转动的, 可循环的, 可轮流的
lemmas.def_en: capable of being rotated

examples.en: The new computer monitor features a rotatable screen that switches easily to portrait mode.
examples.zh: 这款新电脑显示器配有可旋转屏幕，能轻松切换到竖屏模式。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 rotatable 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: (尤指南美洲亚马孙河沿岸的)热带雨林
lemmas.def_en: a rain forest in a tropical area

examples.en: Dense vegetation makes traveling through the Amazonian selva an exhausting, perilous journey.
examples.zh: 茂密的植被让穿越南美热带雨林的旅程变得疲惫而危险。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 selva 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: an Italian title of respect for a man; equivalent to the English `sir'; used separately (not prefixed to his name)

examples.en: The polite hotel receptionist bowed and warmly greeted the distinguished Italian signore.
examples.zh: 礼貌的酒店前台人员微微鞠躬，热情地向这位尊贵的意大利女士问好。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 signore 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a plant fiber used for making rope

examples.en: Local artisans use tough sisal fibers to weave durable mats and rustic rugs.
examples.zh: 当地手艺人使用坚韧的剑麻纤维编织耐用的垫子和质朴的地毯。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 sisal 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a child of your spouse by a former marriage

examples.en: She treated her husband's stepchild with the same love as her own kids.
examples.zh: 她对待丈夫前段婚姻的孩子就像对自己亲生孩子一样关爱。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 stepchild 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 易吃饱的, 塞满的, 平凡的, 庸俗的, 步履艰难的
lemmas.def_en: heavy and starchy and hard to digest

examples.en: After eating a stodgy potato pudding, we all felt far too sleepy to work.
examples.zh: 吃完一份容易让人腹胀的土豆布丁后，我们困得完全没心思工作。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 stodgy 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 帕兰刀(马来人用的带鞘砍刀)
lemmas.def_en: a stout straight knife used in Malaysia and Indonesia

examples.en: He used a heavy parang to hack through the thick jungle growth quickly.
examples.zh: 他用一把沉重的帕兰刀迅速劈开丛林中密集的灌木。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 parang 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 女性保护人, 女资助人, 女主顾
lemmas.def_en: a woman who is a patron or the wife of a patron

examples.en: The wealthy patroness generously funded the young pianist's ambitious debut concert series.
examples.zh: 那位富有的女赞助人慷慨资助了年轻钢琴家的首场巡回音乐会。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 patroness 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 男用无袖短上衣, 短上衣
lemmas.def_en: a tight sleeveless and collarless jacket (often made of leather) worn by men in former times

examples.en: The medieval archer wore a thick leather jerkin to protect his upper body.
examples.zh: 那位中世纪弓箭手穿着厚皮短上衣以保护上半身。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 jerkin 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 运动的, 移动的, 运转的
lemmas.def_en: of or relating to locomotion

examples.en: Rehabilitation exercises helped the injured patient gradually regain normal locomotor functions.
examples.zh: 康复训练帮助这位受伤的患者逐渐恢复了正常的运动功能。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 locomotor 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a garment that provides covering for the loins

examples.en: The ancient tribal warrior wore only a simple woven loincloth into battle.
examples.zh: 那位古代部落勇士仅穿了一块简单的织物缠腰带上阵。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 loincloth 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 到这样的程度, 如此地, 因为, 由于
lemmas.def_en: to such an extent or degree; so

examples.en: The plan succeeded insomuch as everyone completed their assigned tasks on time.
examples.zh: 由于每个人都按时完成了分配的任务，该计划取得了成功。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 insomuch 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: characteristic of a person who is not cultivated or does not have intellectual tastes

examples.en: Critics dismissed the popular slapstick comedy as lowbrow entertainment for the masses.
examples.zh: 评论家们对这部广受欢迎的打闹喜剧不屑一顾，斥其为迎合大众的低俗娱乐。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 lowbrow 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 麦基诺毛毯, 由麦基诺毛毯制成的短衣
lemmas.def_en: a short plaid coat made of made of thick woolen material

examples.en: He bundled up in a thick plaid mackinaw before braving the winter blizzard.
examples.zh: 他套上一件厚实的格子麦基诺短上衣，顶着冬日暴风雪出发。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 mackinaw 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: (Yiddish) a snack or light meal

examples.en: We grabbed a quick nosh at the food truck before the movie started.
examples.zh: 电影开场前，我们在快餐车旁草草吃了点小吃充饥。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 nosh 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: black honeycreepers with yellow feathers around the tail; now extinct

examples.en: The extinct Hawaiian mamo was famed for its stunning, vivid yellow feathers.
examples.zh: 已灭绝的夏威夷马莫蜜鸟以其惊艳夺目的鲜黄羽毛而闻名。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 mamo 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a short thin stick of wood used in making matches

examples.en: He carefully struck a thin wooden matchstick to light the evening campfire.
examples.zh: 他小心翼翼地划亮一根细木火柴，点燃了晚上的营火。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 matchstick 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: the monthly discharge of blood from the uterus of nonpregnant women from puberty to menopause; ; --Hippocrates; --Aristotle

examples.en: Many women experience painful abdominal cramps during the first day of menses.
examples.zh: 许多女性在月经来潮的第一天会出现剧烈下腹痛。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 menses 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: the trait of lacking discipline

examples.en: The coach bench-warmed the star player as punishment for his chronic indiscipline.
examples.zh: 教练罚这位明星球员坐冷板凳，以此惩戒他长期缺乏纪律的行为。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 indiscipline 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: [化] 工厂机械的安装及操作
lemmas.def_en: woodwork that has been machined at a mill

examples.en: The renovation project highlights custom millwork, including detailed oak cabinets and baseboards.
examples.zh: 该翻新项目突出了定制木作制品，包括精细的橡木橱柜和踢脚线。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 millwork 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 不得与外界接触的, 不准与外界通信息的
lemmas.def_en: without the means or right to communicate

examples.en: The prisoner was held incommunicado for two weeks without any access to a lawyer.
examples.zh: 这名囚犯被单独隔离监禁了两周，无法接触律师。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 incommunicado 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 模仿的, 摹拟的, 好模仿的, 类似的
lemmas.def_en: characterized by or of the nature of or using mimesis

examples.en: Certain insects survive in the wild by developing mimetic patterns that resemble poisonous leaves.
examples.zh: 某些昆虫通过形成类似有毒叶片的拟态斑纹在野外存活。

lemmas.def_en: the imitative representation of nature and human behavior in art and literature

examples.en: Classical art often relies heavily on the realistic mimesis of human nature.
examples.zh: 古典艺术往往极大地依赖于对人性的逼真摹仿。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 mimetic 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: (Latin) nil; nothing (as used by a sheriff after an unsuccessful effort to serve a writ)

examples.en: The court ruled that the contract was legally void and reduced to sheer nihil.
examples.zh: 法院裁定该合同在法律上无效，化为彻底的虚无。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 nihil 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a fireproof metal strongbox (usually in a bank) for storing valuables

examples.en: He placed the original property deeds securely inside the metal lockbox under his bed.
examples.zh: 他将房契原件妥善地放进床下的金属密码箱里。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 lockbox 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a book prepared for use in schools or colleges

examples.en: She opened her old schoolbook and smiled at the childish notes written inside.
examples.zh: 她翻开旧教科书，看到里面孩子气的笔记不禁笑了。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 schoolbook 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 不宜提及的, 说不出口的
lemmas.def_en: unsuitable or forbidden as a topic of conversation

examples.en: He considered the family's deepest financial troubles to be an entirely unmentionable topic.
examples.zh: 他认为家族最严重的财务危机是完全难以启齿的话题。

lemmas.def_zh: 不宜说出口之事物, 内衣, 裤子
lemmas.def_en: a garment worn under other garments

examples.en: He considered the family's deepest financial troubles to be an entirely unmentionable topic.
examples.zh: 他认为家族最严重的财务危机是完全难以启齿的话题。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 unmentionable 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 诡辩者, 诡辨家, 学者
lemmas.def_en: any of a group of Greek philosophers and teachers in the 5th century BC who speculated on a wide range of subjects

examples.en: The clever lawyer sounded less like a truth-seeker and more like an agile sophist.
examples.zh: 这位聪明的律师听起来不像在探寻真理，反倒像个圆滑的诡辩者。

lemmas.def_zh: 诡辩的, 诡辩法的, 古代诡辩派的
lemmas.def_en: of or pertaining to sophists

lemmas.def_zh: 诡辩的, 诡辩法的, 古代诡辩派的
lemmas.def_en: plausible but misleading

family_guide.root_logic: 以 sophist 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a fee paid for a nominally free service

examples.en: The guest speaker received a modest honorarium alongside reimbursement for his travel expenses.
examples.zh: 这位特邀演讲嘉宾收到了一笔微薄的酬金，并报销了差旅费。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 honorarium 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 轮流吟唱的歌, 唱和
lemmas.def_en: a verse or song to be chanted or sung in response

examples.en: The cathedral choir sang a traditional Latin antiphon during the solemn evening service.
examples.zh: 大教堂唱诗班在庄严的晚间礼拜中演唱了一首传统的拉丁语交替圣歌。

lemmas.def_zh: 启应轮流吟唱的圣歌诗集
lemmas.def_en: bound collection of antiphons

family_guide.root_logic: 以 antiphon 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: any of the openings to the nasal cavities that allow air to flow through the cavities to the pharynx

examples.en: The doctor examined the patient's left naris to check for any sudden blockage.
examples.zh: 医生检查了患者的左鼻孔，看是否存在突发性阻塞。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 naris 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: the back half of a side of meat

examples.en: The butcher carefully sliced meat from the hindquarter of the beef for steaks.
examples.zh: 屠夫小心地从牛后腿部切下肉来做牛排。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 hindquarter 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 易变的, 不定的, 反复无常的
lemmas.def_en: likely to change frequently often without apparent or cogent reason; variable; ; ; - Shakespeare

examples.en: His inconstant moods made it very difficult for colleagues to work alongside him.
examples.zh: 他反复无常的情绪让同事们很难与他共事。

lemmas.def_zh: 易变, 不定性, 反复无常
lemmas.def_en: unfaithfulness by virtue of being unreliable or treacherous

family_guide.root_logic: 以 inconstant 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 绒毛膜, 浆膜, 卵壳
lemmas.def_en: the outermost membranous sac enclosing the embryo in higher vertebrates (reptiles, birds and mammals)

examples.en: The protective chorion surrounds the developing embryo during its earliest stages of life.
examples.zh: 在生命最初阶段，保护性的绒毛膜包裹着发育中的胚胎。

lemmas.def_en: of or relating to a chorion

examples.en: a chorionic villus is a minute vascular projection on the fetal chorion

family_guide.root_logic: 以 chorion 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: the quality of being salubrious and invigorating

examples.en: Many retired couples moved to the coastal village to enjoy the salubrity of its air.
examples.zh: 许多退休夫妇搬到这个沿海村庄，以享受这里有益健康的清新空气。

lemmas.def_zh: 有益健康的, 健康的
lemmas.def_en: promoting health; healthful; ; ; ; ; - C.B.Davis

examples.en: a healthy diet
clean healthy air

family_guide.root_logic: 以 salubrity 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 作成花圈, 环绕, 盘绕, 使笼罩；扭曲, 成圈, 缭绕
lemmas.def_en: move with slow, sinuous movements

examples.en: Thick morning mist began to wreathe the ancient stone bridge in an ethereal glow.
examples.zh: 清晨浓厚的薄雾开始笼罩古老的石桥，泛起一层空灵的光晕。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 wreathe 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: unite on a federal basis or band together as a league

examples.en: The government decided to federalize the regional transport networks to ensure uniform safety standards.
examples.zh: 政府决定将区域交通网络联邦化，以确保统一的安全标准。

lemmas.def_en: the state of being under federal control

examples.en: the federalization of postal service

family_guide.root_logic: 以 federalize 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 下层绒毛, 底漆, 内涂层
lemmas.def_en: seal consisting of a coating of a tar or rubberlike material on the underside of a motor vehicle to retard corrosion

examples.en: Apply a durable undercoat to the bare wood before you brush on the final color.
examples.zh: 在刷上最终面漆之前，先在裸木上涂一层耐用的底漆。

lemmas.def_en: cover with a primer; apply a primer to

examples.en: Apply a durable undercoat to the bare wood before you brush on the final color.
examples.zh: 在刷上最终面漆之前，先在裸木上涂一层耐用的底漆。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 undercoat 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: wash out with a solvent, as in chromatography

examples.en: The chemist used an organic solvent to elute the target compounds from the column.
examples.zh: 化学家使用有机溶剂从色谱柱中洗脱出目标化合物。

lemmas.def_en: the process of extracting one material from another by washing with a solvent to remove adsorbed material from an adsorbent (as in washing of loaded ion-exchange resins to remove captured ions); used to obtain uranium ions

family_guide.root_logic: 以 elute 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 无信仰的, 不敬神的, 不虔诚的, 不孝的
lemmas.def_en: lacking piety or reverence for a god

examples.en: The crowd gasped at the hermit's impious remarks regarding the ancient temple gods.
examples.zh: 人群对隐士对古寺神明做出的不敬言论感到震惊。

lemmas.def_zh: 不信神地, 不虔诚地
lemmas.def_en: in an impious manner

examples.en: the young members challenged their leader impiously

family_guide.root_logic: 以 impious 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: in a willing manner

examples.en: I had as lief walk through the rain as wait for that crowded bus.
examples.zh: 我宁愿冒雨走回去，也不愿等那趟拥挤的公交车。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 lief 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 好像真实, 似真, 逼真
lemmas.def_en: the appearance of truth; the quality of seeming to be true

examples.en: The historical novel achieved great verisimilitude through its accurate use of period dialogue.
examples.zh: 这部历史小说通过准确运用当时的对话，达到了极高的逼真度。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 verisimilitude 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: any of various climbing plants of the genus Vicia having pinnately compound leaves that terminate in tendrils and small variously colored flowers; includes valuable forage and soil-building plants

examples.en: The farmer planted purple vetch to enrich the exhausted soil with nitrogen.
examples.zh: 农民种植了紫云英野豌豆，以给贫瘠的土壤增加氮素。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 vetch 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a person who owns or operates oil wells

examples.en: The wealthy oilman invested millions of dollars into developing renewable energy sources.
examples.zh: 这位富有的石油商投资了数百万美元开发可再生能源。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 oilman 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 福利, 幸福, 鞭痕
lemmas.def_en: a raised mark on the skin (as produced by the blow of a whip); characteristic of many allergic reactions

examples.en: True leaders always act selflessly for the common weal of the nation.
examples.zh: 真正的领导人总是为了国家的公共福利而无私奉献。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 weal 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: [常作Z-][空]策帕林飞艇,齐柏林飞艇(一种硬式飞艇)
lemmas.def_en: a large sandwich made of a long crusty roll split lengthwise and filled with meats and cheese (and tomato and onion and lettuce and condiments); different names are used in different sections of the United States

examples.en: A massive German Zep floated silently above the clouds during the raid.
examples.zh: 空袭期间，一艘巨大的德国齐柏林飞艇在云层上方悄然漂浮。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 zep 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: occurring in more than one stage

examples.en: Engineers carefully tested the multistage rocket before the historic satellite launch took place.
examples.zh: 在进行历史性的卫星发射之前，工程师们仔细测试了多级火箭。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 multistage 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 漫步, 徘徊, 离去
lemmas.def_en: walk leisurely

examples.en: After a heavy lunch, we decided to mosey down to the waterfront.
examples.zh: 吃过一顿丰盛的午餐后，我们决定漫步到海滨去。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 mosey 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 没有遗嘱的, 无遗嘱嘱明处置的
lemmas.def_en: having made no legally valid will before death or not disposed of by a legal will

examples.en: Because the wealthy businessman died intestate, the court will divide his vast estate.
examples.zh: 由于这位富商去世时未立遗嘱，法院将对其庞大财产进行分割。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 intestate 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a person who has undergone a sex change operation

examples.en: The support clinic offers valuable healthcare and legal counseling for every transexual patient.
examples.zh: 该支持诊所为每一位跨性别患者提供宝贵的医疗和法律咨询。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 transexual 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: stone post at side of a road to show distances

examples.en: We took a short rest when we reached the fiftieth milepost along the trail.
examples.zh: 当我们沿着小径走到第50个里程碑时，稍作了休息。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 milepost 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: neuroglial tissue of mesodermal origin that can become phagocytic

examples.en: Activated microglia help clear damaged cellular debris from the central nervous system.
examples.zh: 活化的小胶质细胞有助于清除中枢神经系统中受损的细胞碎片。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 microglia 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: toward land

examples.en: The coastal fishermen steered their small boats landward as a violent storm approached.
examples.zh: 暴风雨来临时，沿海渔民们将小船驶向陆地方向。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 landward 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 乞丐, 乞讨, 托钵僧
lemmas.def_en: a male member of a religious order that originally relied solely on alms

examples.en: A humble mendicant sat on the temple steps asking for small donations.
examples.zh: 一位谦逊的托钵僧坐在寺庙台阶上化缘。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 mendicant 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 失恋的, 害相思病的
lemmas.def_en: unhappy in love; suffering from unrequited love

examples.en: The lovelorn youth spent hours writing mournful poetry about his departed lover.
examples.zh: 这位害相思病的青年花了数小时为离去的爱人写哀伤的诗歌。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 lovelorn 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: laparotomy performed with a laparoscope that makes a small incision to examine the abdominal cavity (especially the ovaries and Fallopian tubes)

examples.en: She recovered much faster because the gallbladder removal was performed using advanced laparoscopy.
examples.zh: 由于胆囊切除术采用先进的腹腔镜检查技术进行，她恢复得快得多。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 laparoscopy 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: the introductory section of a story

examples.en: The editor told the young reporter to rewrite the lede to grab attention.
examples.zh: 编辑让年轻记者重写新闻导语，以吸引读者的注意。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 lede 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: pasta in long slender flat strips

examples.en: The waiter served a steaming plate of homemade linguine tossed with fresh seafood.
examples.zh: 服务员端上一盘热气腾腾、拌着新鲜海鲜的自制意大利扁面条。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 linguine 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: sores resulting from a tropical infection by protozoa of the genus Leishmania which are spread by sandflies

examples.en: Sandflies transmit leishmaniasis, a parasitic disease affecting thousands in tropical regions.
examples.zh: 白蛉传播利什曼病，这是一种在热带地区危害成千上万人的寄生虫病。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 leishmaniasis 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a usually cotton fabric with a short pile imitating velvet

examples.en: She wore a dark green velveteen jacket to the formal evening gala.
examples.zh: 她穿了一件深绿色平绒夹克参加正式晚会。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 velveteen 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: used of competition or cooperation between secondary schools

examples.en: Students from five high schools participated in the intense interscholastic debate tournament.
examples.zh: 来自五所高中的学生参加了这场激烈的校际辩论赛。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 interscholastic 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: an ornamental but poisonous flowering shrub having narrow evergreen leaves and clusters of fragrant white to pink or red flowers: native to East Indies but widely cultivated in warm regions

examples.en: Although beautiful, the pink oleander growing in our backyard is extremely poisonous.
examples.zh: 虽然美丽，但长在我们后院的粉色夹竹桃却毒性极大。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 oleander 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a sail (or either of a pair of sails) immediately above the lowermost sail of a mast and supported by a topmast

examples.en: The crew climbed the rigging swiftly to unfurl the ship's massive topsail.
examples.zh: 船员们迅速爬上索具，展开了船上巨大的上桅帆。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 topsail 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 脚尖旋转, 快速旋转
lemmas.def_en: (ballet) a rapid spin of the body (especially on the toes as in ballet)

examples.en: The graceful ballerina executed a flawless pirouette before landing softly on the stage.
examples.zh: 优雅的芭蕾舞演员完成了一个无瑕的单脚旋转，随后轻盈地落在舞台上。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 pirouette 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a person of great and varied learning

examples.en: Leonardo da Vinci was a true polymath who mastered painting, engineering, and anatomy.
examples.zh: 列奥纳多·达·芬奇是一位真正的博学者，精通绘画、工程和解剖学。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 polymath 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a salt of perchloric acid

examples.en: Scientists detected trace amounts of perchlorate in the local drinking water supply.
examples.zh: 科学家在当地饮用水供应中检测到了微量的高氯酸盐。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 perchlorate 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a medical dressing consisting of a soft heated mass of meal or clay that is spread on a cloth and applied to the skin to treat inflamed areas or improve circulation etc.

examples.en: She applied a warm herbal poultice to soothe her swollen, aching ankle.
examples.zh: 她敷上温热的草药泥罨剂以缓解肿痛的脚踝。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 poultice 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a stout lever with a sharp spike; used for handling logs

examples.en: The lumberjack used a heavy peavy to roll the massive pine log.
examples.zh: 伐木工用一根沉重的钩棍翻动巨大的松木。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 peavy 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: any of several bases that are derivatives of purine

examples.en: Patients with gout are advised to avoid foods that are rich in purine.
examples.zh: 痛风患者被建议避免食用富含嘌呤的食物。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 purine 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a quadrilateral whose opposite sides are both parallel and equal in length

examples.en: The teacher drew a parallelogram on the chalkboard to explain its geometric properties.
examples.zh: 老师在黑板上画了一个平行四边形来解释其几何特性。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 parallelogram 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 正直, 纯正, 正确
lemmas.def_en: righteousness as a consequence of being honorable and honest

examples.en: Throughout his political career, he was widely respected for his unyielding moral rectitude.
examples.zh: 在整个政治生涯中，他因坚定不移的道德正直而广受尊敬。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 rectitude 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 唠叨, 拍马屁, 交涉, 用花言巧语骗人；笼络, 哄骗
lemmas.def_en: speak (about unimportant matters) rapidly and incessantly

examples.en: Stop palavering with the salesman and make a final decision on the car.
examples.zh: 别再和推销员磨嘴皮子了，赶紧把车定下来吧。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 palaver 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: interpretive or explanatory

examples.en: The scholar adopted a hermeneutic approach to analyze ancient philosophical manuscripts.
examples.zh: 这位学者采用了解释学的方法来分析古代哲学手稿。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 hermeneutic 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 信仰复兴运动者, 领导宗教复兴运动者
lemmas.def_en: a preacher of the Christian gospel

examples.en: The fiery revivalist traveled across the country, preaching to thousands in large tents.
examples.zh: 这位热情的布道复兴者巡回全国，在大帐篷里向数千人传教。

lemmas.def_zh: （尤指宗教的）奋兴运动; 复兴, 复古
lemmas.def_en: an attempt to reawaken the evangelical faith

examples.en: The community experienced a surge of religious revivalism during the late nineteenth century.
examples.zh: 该社区在十九世纪末经历了一股宗教奋兴运动的热潮。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 revivalist 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: [植] 洛神葵(产于热带地区)
lemmas.def_en: East Indian sparsely prickly annual herb or perennial subshrub widely cultivated for its fleshy calyxes used in tarts and jelly and for its bast fiber

examples.en: She brewed a refreshing crimson tea using dried petals of the roselle plant.
examples.zh: 她用洛神葵的干花瓣泡制了一壶提神的绯红花茶。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 roselle 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a soft silvery metallic element of the alkali metal group; burns in air and reacts violently in water; occurs in carnallite and lepidolite and pollucite

examples.en: Rubidium is a highly reactive soft metal that ignites spontaneously in moist air.
examples.zh: 铷是一种高活性的软金属，在潮湿空气中会自燃。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 rubidium 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a fast movement (usually in triple time)

examples.en: The orchestra performed the lively scherzo with remarkable precision and playful energy.
examples.zh: 管弦乐队以极高的精准度和欢快的活力演奏了这首活泼的诙谐曲。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 scherzo 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: the time of life when you are going to school

examples.en: Looking through the old yearbook brought back fond memories of our happy schooldays.
examples.zh: 翻看旧年鉴唤起了我们对快乐学生时代的美好回忆。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 schooldays 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: an autoimmune disease that affects the blood vessels and connective tissue; fibrous connective tissue is deposited in the skin

examples.en: Doctors ran comprehensive blood tests to confirm the suspected diagnosis of systemic scleroderma.
examples.zh: 医生进行了全面的血液检查以确认疑似系统性硬皮病的诊断。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 scleroderma 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 食品与炊具洗涤处, 食品与炊具存放室
lemmas.def_en: a small room (in large old British houses) next to the kitchen; where kitchen utensils are cleaned and kept and other rough household jobs are done

examples.en: The kitchen maid spent hours washing greasy copper pans in the cold scullery.
examples.zh: 厨房女仆在阴冷的洗涤室里花了好几个小时刷洗油腻的铜锅。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 scullery 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: treatment of symptoms by applying pressure with the fingers to specific pressure points on the body

examples.en: After a stressful week, she booked a shiatsu session to relieve muscle tension.
examples.zh: 度过紧张的一周后，她预约了一次指压按摩以缓解肌肉紧张。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 shiatsu 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a fine-grained sandstone of consolidated silt

examples.en: Geologists found ancient marine fossil impressions preserved within the fine-grained siltstone.
examples.zh: 地质学家在细粒粉砂岩中发现了保存完好的古代海洋化石印痕。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 siltstone 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: of or relating to the somatosenses

examples.en: The somatosensory cortex processes signals related to touch, temperature, and bodily pain.
examples.zh: 躯体感觉皮层负责处理与触觉、温度和身体疼痛相关的信号。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 somatosensory 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a light loose sleeveless summer dress with a wide neckline and thin shoulder straps that expose the arms and shoulders

examples.en: She wore a lightweight floral sundress while strolling along the sunlit beach.
examples.zh: 漫步在阳光明媚的海滩上时，她穿了一条轻便的碎花太阳裙。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 sundress 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: medium-sized larch of Canada and northern United States including Alaska having a broad conic crown and rust-brown scaly bark

examples.en: The needles of the tamarack tree turn brilliant gold before dropping in autumn.
examples.zh: 美洲落叶松的针叶在秋季脱落前会变成灿烂的金色。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 tamarack 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: [日]短歌(三十一音节字的日本诗体)
lemmas.def_en: a form of Japanese poetry; the 1st and 3rd lines have five syllables and the 2nd, 4th, and 5th have seven syllables

examples.en: The poet composed an elegant tanka reflecting on the fleeting nature of spring.
examples.zh: 诗人写了一首优雅的短歌，感慨春光的短暂易逝。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 tanka 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: located or occurring between the ribs

examples.en: He pulled an intercostal muscle while lifting heavy boxes during the house move.
examples.zh: 他在搬家搬运重箱子时不慎拉伤了肋间肌。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 intercostal 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 光度学, 光度测定, 测光法
lemmas.def_en: measurement of the properties of light (especially luminous intensity)

examples.en: Astronomers use high-precision photometry to detect slight variations in distant starlight.
examples.zh: 天文学家利用高精度测光法来探测遥远星光的微小变化。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 photometry 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: having eight units or components

examples.en: The company saw an eightfold increase in profits after launching its new digital service.
examples.zh: 公司推出新的数字化服务后，利润增长了八倍。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 eightfold 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 阻碍, 妨害物, 累赘
lemmas.def_en: an onerous or difficult concern

examples.en: He sold the property to clear all existing debts without any further legal encumbrance.
examples.zh: 他卖掉房产以清偿所有现有债务，摆脱进一步的法律累赘。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 encumbrance 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: <法>一种指形小饼（糖霜衣, 乳酪馅）
lemmas.def_en: oblong cream puff

examples.en: She bought a fresh chocolate eclair from the corner bakery for an afternoon treat.
examples.zh: 她在街角烘焙店买了一个新鲜的巧克力指形小饼当作午后甜点。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 eclair 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 被吓得发愣的, 惊呆的
lemmas.def_en: as if struck dumb with astonishment and surprise

examples.en: He stood dumbstruck as the unexpected news completely shattered all of his weekend plans.
examples.zh: 突如其来的消息彻底打乱了他的周末计划，他惊得目瞪口呆。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 dumbstruck 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 煽动, 煽动行为, 散布谣言
lemmas.def_en: impassioned appeals to the prejudices and emotions of the populace

examples.en: The politician relied on cheap demagoguery rather than realistic policies to win the election.
examples.zh: 那位政客依靠廉价的煽动手段而非务实的政策来赢得选举。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 demagoguery 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: an evil supernatural being

examples.en: Ancient philosophers believed that an inner daimon guided a person's fate and moral choices.
examples.zh: 古代哲学家认为，内心的神灵或守护神指引着一个人的命运和道德抉择。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 daimon 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a common venereal disease caused by the bacterium Neisseria gonorrhoeae; symptoms are painful urination and pain around the urethra

examples.en: Routine medical screening can detect gonorrhoea early and prevent further severe health complications.
examples.zh: 常规医学筛查可以早期发现淋病，防止进一步引发严重的并发症。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 gonorrhoea 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a bass horn (brass wind instrument) that is the tenor of the tuba family

examples.en: The brass band player practiced the euphonium diligently for two hours every single day.
examples.zh: 这位铜管乐手每天都坚持刻苦练习两小时次中音号。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 euphonium 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: small jar; holds liquid (oil or water)

examples.en: The old monk poured fragrant oil from a small clay cruse onto the altar.
examples.zh: 老僧侣从小陶壶中倒出香油，洒在祭坛上。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 cruse 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: shaped like a cross

examples.en: The medieval cathedral was carefully designed and built in a classic cruciform layout.
examples.zh: 这座中世纪大教堂经过精心设计，采用了经典的十字形布局。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 cruciform 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 女服胸部, 胸衣, 装饰花
lemmas.def_en: an arrangement of flowers that is usually given as a present

examples.en: He pinned a delicate rose corsage onto her elegant dress before the formal prom.
examples.zh: 在正式舞会前，他把一朵精致的玫瑰胸花别在她优雅的礼服上。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 corsage 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: anterior portion of the brain consisting of two hemispheres; dominant part of the brain in humans

examples.en: The cerebrum controls conscious thought, memory, speech, and voluntary movement in the human body.
examples.zh: 大脑控制着人体的意识思维、记忆、言语和随意运动。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 cerebrum 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 钮孔, 钮眼, 胸花
lemmas.def_en: a hole through which buttons are pushed

examples.en: The groom placed a miniature white flower carefully into his jacket buttonhole before entering.
examples.zh: 新郎进门前仔细地将一朵微型白花插入西装钮孔中。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 buttonhole 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 怪物；棘手的难题；恐惧或烦恼的原因
lemmas.def_en: an imaginary monster used to frighten children

examples.en: Punctuality has always been a major bugbear for the otherwise talented young designer.
examples.zh: 守时一直是让这位本来很有才华的年轻设计师非常头疼的难题。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 bugbear 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: two-masted sailing vessel square-rigged on the foremast and fore-and-aft rigged on the mainmast

examples.en: A two-masted brigantine sailed swiftly into the natural harbor under a stiff coastal breeze.
examples.zh: 一艘双桅帆船在强劲的岸风下疾速驶入了天然海港。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 brigantine 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: meat from an adult domestic bovine

examples.en: The restaurant is renowned for serving authentic boeuf bourguignon with fresh crusty bread.
examples.zh: 这家餐厅以供应地道的勃艮第炖牛肉搭配新鲜脆皮面包而闻名。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 boeuf 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: smiling with happiness or optimism; - Lewis Carroll

examples.en: The beamish boy smiled widely after receiving the first-place trophy at the science fair.
examples.zh: 在科学竞赛中获得一等奖奖杯后，那个满面春风的男孩笑得格外灿烂。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 beamish 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 无臂的, 无扶手的, 无武器的
lemmas.def_en: having no arms

examples.en: They bought an armless sofa to save space in the compact city apartment living room.
examples.zh: 他们买了一张无扶手沙发，以节省紧凑型城市公寓客厅的空间。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 armless 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 近日点, 最高点, 顶点
lemmas.def_en: periapsis in solar orbit; the point in the orbit of a planet or comet where it is nearest to the sun

examples.en: The comet moves fastest through its orbit when it is closest to perihelion.
examples.zh: 彗星在轨道上运行到最接近近日点时速度最快。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 perihelion 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: (与)历史无关的, (无)历史记载的
lemmas.def_en: unconcerned with or unrelated to history or to historical development or to tradition

examples.en: Critics condemned the modern movie for presenting an entirely ahistorical version of the war.
examples.zh: 影评人谴责这部现代电影完全脱离历史地再现了那场战争。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 ahistorical 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: the practice of plundering in gangs

examples.en: Local authorities increased armed patrols to curb the recent rise in violent highway banditry.
examples.zh: 地方当局增加了武装巡逻，以遏制近期公路匪帮暴行上升的势头。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 banditry 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: capable of relieving pain

examples.en: The doctor prescribed an anodyne syrup to help soothe the patient's persistent toothache.
examples.zh: 医生开了一种止痛糖浆，以帮助缓解患者持续的牙痛。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 anodyne 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: mat together and make felt-like

examples.en: Careful washing is required, or the warm water will felt the delicate wool fibers.
examples.zh: 清洗时必须小心，否则温水会使脆弱的羊毛纤维粘结成毡。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 felted 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a plant hormone that promotes root formation and bud growth

examples.en: The plant hormone auxin regulates stem growth by directing cells toward natural sunlight.
examples.zh: 植物激素生长素通过引导细胞朝向自然阳光来调节茎部的生长。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 auxin 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: immoderately desirous of acquiring e.g. wealth

examples.en: The toddler became very grabby whenever another child picked up his favorite toy truck.
examples.zh: 每当有其他孩子拿起他心爱的玩具卡车，这个蹒跚学步的孩子就变得极爱争抢。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 grabby 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 腹部, 瘤胃, 大肚子
lemmas.def_en: a protruding abdomen

examples.en: Years of desk work and fine wine had given him a noticeable paunch.
examples.zh: 多年的伏案工作和美酒让他挺起了明显的大肚子。

lemmas.def_zh: 大肚子的, 大腹便便的
lemmas.def_en: having a large belly

family_guide.root_logic: 以 paunch 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 供应食物给；吃, 贮藏食品
lemmas.def_en: supply with food

examples.en: The captain docked at the harbor to victual his ship for the voyage.
examples.zh: 船长在港口靠岸，为接下来的航程给船只补充给养。

lemmas.def_zh: 供应食物者, 运粮船
